description: This file defines the NodeInterface interface within the OrangeHRM system's ORM NestedSet namespace. It specifies the contract for nodes in a nested set hierarchy, including methods for managing parent-child relationships and node properties.

methods.name: hasChildren
methods.description: Checks if the node has any children.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Retrieves child nodes up to the specified depth.

methods.name: hasParent
methods.description: Checks if the node has a parent node.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent node if exists.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the level of the node within the hierarchy.

methods.name: insertAsLastChildOf
methods.description: Inserts the current node as the last child of the specified parent node.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a specified node as a child to the current node.

methods.name: isLeaf
methods.description: Determines if the node is a leaf node (has no children).

methods.name: isRoot
methods.description: Determines if the node is a root node (no parent).

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes this node and its descendants.
